fields.mechanism: Adsorption of arsenic by magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles embedded in a porous cellulose matrix.
fields.intervention: Embed magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles into the porous clay or sand matrix of the rural water filter to create a passive adsorption layer that captures arsenic without electricity or chemicals.
fields.expected_effect: Reduction of arsenic concentration in groundwater to below the WHO limit of 10 μg·L -1 through passive filtration.
fields.falsification_test: Pass arsenic-contaminated groundwater through a prototype filter containing the nanoparticle-embedded matrix and measure effluent arsenic levels; failure is confirmed if levels remain above 10 μg·L -1.

fields.mechanism: Adsorption of arsenic by magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles embedded in a porous cellulose matrix.
fields.intervention: Replace the standard filter media in the rural water filter with pulverized eggshells and magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles enclosed within a Bemliese teabag structure to create a passive, chemical-free adsorption cartridge.
fields.expected_effect: Reduction of arsenic concentrations in groundwater to below the WHO limit of 10 μg·L -1 without requiring electricity or added liquid chemicals.
fields.falsification_test: Pass groundwater containing 50 μg·L -1 of arsenic through the modified filter at a rural household flow rate and measure the effluent; if the concentration remains above 10 μg·L -1, the mechanism fails in this configuration.
